summary: The change modifies the idempotency guard in the payment release function: a previously returned confirmation is reused only when the original release was less than 24 hours old, after which a replayed instruction triggers a second disbursement to core banking. This directly violates PAY-2, which requires that releasing the same instruction again never sends a second disbursement. All other applicable product obligations (PAY-1, MC-1) and process obligations (CHG-1 through CHG-7, EXC-1, LAP-1) are satisfied. Because PAY-2 is refuted, the change must be rejected.
